chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Musa ibn Sa'dan, from Abdullah ibn al-Qasim, from Abd al-Qahhar, from Jabir al-Ju'fi, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:

The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Whoever would be pleased to live my life, and to die my death, and to enter the Paradise which my Lord has promised me, and to hold fast to a branch that my Lord planted with His own hand — let him take Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him) and his successors after him as his guardians, for they will not lead you into a gate of straying, nor will they take you out from a gate of guidance.

Therefore do not try to teach them, for they are more knowledgeable than you are. And I asked my Lord that there be no separation between them and the Book until they both arrive at the Pool together — like this,' and he joined his two fingers, 'and its breadth is what lies between Sana'a and Ayla, and therein are cups of silver and gold numbering the stars.'

key_terms.أَوْصِيَاء: successors, those entrusted with the legacy (awsiya), the Imams after Ali
key_terms.الْحَوْض: the Pool (Hawd/Kawthar), the eschatological pool at which the Prophet will receive believers on the Day of Judgment
key_terms.ضَلَال: straying, misguidance, deviation from the right path
key_terms.قَضِيب: branch, rod, sapling — a metaphor for the Imamate planted by divine will
key_terms.يَتَمَسَّكَ: holds fast, clings to, adheres to

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about following Ali ibn Abi Talib and the Imams to enter Paradise?
ai.summary: This hadith, narrated through the fifth Imam al-Baqir from the Prophet, presents the Prophet Muhammad's declaration that wilaya (guardianship/authority) of Ali ibn Abi Talib and his successors is the path to salvation, mirroring the Prophet's own life, death, and promised paradise. The Ahl al-Bayt are inseparably linked to the Quran, and together they will arrive at the Pool of Kawthar on the Day of Judgment. The hadith is part of the chapter on what God and the Prophet have designated as obligatory from creation — specifically the Imamate. The audience of early Muslim followers would have immediately understood the eschatological imagery of the Pool of Kawthar (mentioned in Quran 108:1) as a vivid promise of intercession and salvation.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Musa Bin Sa’dan, from Abdullah Bin Al Qasim, from Abdul Qahar, from Jabir Al Ju’fy, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The one who is happy that he should live (like) my<sup>saww</sup> life, and be dying (like) my<sup>saww</sup> death, and enter the Paradise which my<sup>saww</sup> Lord<sup>azwj</sup> has Promised us, and attach himself with a branch which my<sup>azwj</sup> Lord<sup>azwj</sup> Planted with His<sup>azwj</sup> Own Hands, so let him befriend Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Abu Talib<sup>asws</sup> and the successors<sup>asws</sup> from after him<sup>asws</sup>, for they<sup>asws</sup> will not enter you into a door of straying, nor will they exit you from a door of guidance.

Therefore, do not try to teach them<sup>asws</sup>, for they<sup>asws</sup> are more knowledgeable than you are, and I<sup>saww</sup> asked my<sup>saww</sup> Lord<sup>azwj</sup> that they<sup>asws</sup> should be no separation between them<sup>asws</sup> and the Book until they<sup>asws</sup> return to me<sup>saww</sup> are the Fountain, like this’, and he<sup>saww</sup> joined between his<sup>saww</sup> fingers, ‘and its width is what is between Sana’a (a city of Yemen) up to Ayla (a place between Makkah and Al-Medina), therein are cups of silver and gold of the number of the stars’.
en.sarwar: 6. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Musa ibn Sa‘dan from ‘Abdallah ibn al-Qasim from ’Abd al-Qahhar from Jabir al-Ju‘fi from abu Ja’far ( a.s.) who has said that the Messenger of Allah has said the following. “Whoever would like to live as I have lived and die as will do and enter the garden that my Lord has promised to me and hold in hands the stick that Allah has planted with His own hands he then must love and acknowledge (Leadership with Divine Authority of) Ali (a.s.) and his successors after him because they do not lead you into the gates of misguidance or take you out the gate of true guidance.
Thus, do not try to teach them because they know more then you do.

I have asked my Lord not to cause any separation between them and the Holy Quran until the time they will arrive in my presence near the al-Kawthar in paradise like this (showing his two fingers stretched side by side). The pond of al-Kawthar which is as big as from San‘a’ to ’Ayla (a place between Makka and Madina) with cups of gold and silver around it as many as the stars.
